description: Population potentially exposed to passenger rail noise, 2018 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. This table shows the number and percent of people in the contiguous United States (excludes Alaska and Hawaii) potentially exposed to different levels of noise from passenger rail sources. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 3 columns, among them A-weighted 24-hour LAEQ (dBA), Population exposed, 2018, Percent of total population in 2018. The portal shows 2020-07-15 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
